intro.h2: Bathrooms with real character, built by carpenters
paragraphs: Very Good Carpentry handles bathroom remodeling in Lafayette, and its clients describe the results as a true transformation. One client had a primary bath so small there was barely room to photograph it. It now has stone-look walls, a deep soaking tub and brass fixtures, and she calls it the most amazing bathroom in Lafayette.

The crew are woodworkers as much as remodelers. They have built a solid mahogany floating vanity with the plumbing hidden inside, white oak furniture and walnut inlay pieces. That eye for detail shows in every tile niche and vanity. Reviewers mention quality work, accurate pricing and a project that came in on time and on budget.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Lafayette, plus kitchens and custom wood

items.name: Full bathroom remodels
items.blurb: From the studs out: new tile, new tub or shower, vanity, lighting and fixtures. One client swapped a jetted tub for a soaker and a plastic surround for real tile to the ceiling, with recessed LED lights over the vanity.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom with dark stone-look shower walls, a white soaking tub and a brushed brass shower set

items.name: Tile showers and tub surrounds
items.blurb: Floor-to-ceiling tile, built-in shampoo niches and clean glass. Past jobs include glossy green herringbone showers with a wood slat bench, vertical stacked green tile around a tub, and stone-look wall panels framed in brushed brass trim.

image.alt: Tub surround in dark green vertical tile running to the ceiling, with a recessed shampoo niche

items.name: Bathroom and closet additions
items.blurb: Need more space, not just a refresh? The crew has taken a bathroom and walk-in closet addition from a blank slate to a finished suite, with a tiled shower, built-in vanity and closet, working alongside the homeowners through the entire project.

image.alt: New walk-in closet with hanging rods and wood floors, part of a bathroom and closet addition

items.name: Custom vanities and built-ins
items.blurb: Because this is a carpentry shop, vanities can be built rather than bought. One favorite: a solid mahogany vanity floating on the wall, with the plumbing rerouted to hide inside the cabinet. Shelving, linen cabinets and trim get the same attention.

image.alt: Fluted wood floating vanity with a white top, lighted round mirror and brass towel ladder in a burgundy bathroom

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Very Good Carpentry lists full kitchen remodels alongside bathrooms as its specialty. Call to talk through cabinets, layout, countertops and finish carpentry for your kitchen, and ask Josh about the kitchens the crew has already built.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a remodeled kitchen in a Lafayette, Louisiana home: warm white oak cabinets with simple slab doors, a honey-toned wood open shelf, cream quartz countertops, a deep green glossy tile backsplash, brushed brass hardware and faucet, wide plank wood floor, soft natural daylight from a window with live oak trees outside; no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names. Aspect ratio 4:3.
image.alt: Illustration: kitchen with white oak cabinets, cream countertops and a green tile backsplash

items.name: Custom furniture and woodwork
items.blurb: The shop also builds one-off pieces: a matching dining table and bench in solid white oak, a midcentury zebra wood headboard with built-in reading lamps, and walnut inlays set into a cypress trunk cross cut.

image.alt: Solid white oak dining bench with square legs, built by Very Good Carpentry

items.title: They build your vision, not theirs
items.text: Clients describe explaining their idea and seeing it brought to life. Bold colors, brass, green tile and dark stone are all on the table if that is what you want.

items.title: Honest pricing, on budget
items.text: One reviewer called the pricing accurate. Another summed up her project in three lines: on time, on budget, vision brought to life.

items.title: Real carpenters on the job
items.text: Reviewers call the crew artists and craftsmen. The same hands that build solid wood furniture build your vanity, shelving and trim, so the details line up.

items.title: Communication and a clean site
items.text: With 15 years in construction and remodeling, the company commits to three things: excellent communication, craftsmanship and cleanliness. Every Google review so far is five stars.

about.h2: Meet Josh and the Very Good Carpentry crew
about.text: Very Good Carpentry LLC is a Lafayette remodeling company. Josh Romero is the company's main contact and leads the crew on site, and reviewers also mention Matt by name. The team brings 15 years of experience in construction and remodeling and focuses on full bathroom and kitchen remodels. Between remodels, the shop builds furniture and woodwork in mahogany, white oak, walnut and zebra wood, which explains the care that goes into every vanity and niche. The company's promise is simple: excellent communication, craftsmanship and cleanliness.

image.alt: White square soaking tub with a brushed brass shower wand and a stone-look wall niche

process.h2: How a remodel with us works

steps.title: Tell us your vision
steps.text: Call or email and describe the room you want. Bring photos, colors and ideas, even for a tiny bathroom with barely room to stand.

steps.title: Plan and price
steps.text: Josh walks the space with you, works out the layout, tile, fixtures and any custom wood pieces, and gives you a price to review.

steps.title: Demo and build
steps.text: The crew strips the room back, handles framing, plumbing changes and lighting, then sets tile, tub or shower and the vanity.

steps.title: Finish carpentry and walkthrough
steps.text: Trim, shelves and fixtures go in last. Then you walk through the finished room with the crew before they pack up.

items.name: Jonathan G.
items.text: We are extremely happy with the work and vision provided by Very Good Carpentry.  We’ve been planning a bathroom and walk in closet addition and the team worked with us throughout the entire project.  We went from a blank slate to the bathroom of our dreams. It is rare finding a craftsman who you can trust, provides accurate pricing and delivers such quality work.  We are extremely satisfied with the completed project.  Thank you VGC!

items.name: Claire F.
items.text:
VGC hooked me up, y’all!! I explained my vision to Josh and Matt for my small primary bathroom and these guys brought it to life in the most amazing way possible.

These guys are Artists AND Craftsmen! Now I have the most amazing bathroom in Lafayette…possibly the world.

Including before pics in here so you get an idea of the real transformation. As you can see, there was barely enough room in there to take pictures of it.

On time. On budget. My vision brought to life!

items.name: Erinn Q.
items.text:
Josh and his crew renovated our bathroom at the beginning of the year.
Switched out the nasty jetted tub to a jet less soaker, replaced the plastic wrap around “tile” tub backsplash piece with real tiles all the way from tub to ceiling, replaced fixtures, vanity, ceiling light/fan combo and added recessed led lighting above the vanity and along that wall.
We love it!
VCG made our dream bathroom a reality
Quality work, quality guys

(Blue bathroom pics are from a 2018 “facelift” to keep us happy till the real deal )

service_area.text: Very Good Carpentry is based in Lafayette, Louisiana, and one reviewer calls her remodeled bath the most amazing bathroom in Lafayette. If you live in or around Lafayette and are planning a bathroom, kitchen or closet project, call (337) 380-6913 or email vgcarpentry@yahoo.com and tell Josh where you are. He will let you know whether your address fits the crew's schedule.

items.q: What kind of projects do you take on?
items.a: The company specializes in full bathroom and kitchen remodels. Past jobs include tile showers and tub surrounds, tub swaps, new vanities and lighting, and a bathroom and walk-in closet addition. The shop also builds custom furniture and woodwork in solid hardwoods.

Yes. Very Good Carpentry is a Lafayette company, and one reviewer calls her remodeled bath the most amazing bathroom in Lafayette. If you are in a nearby town, call (337) 380-6913 and ask whether your project fits the schedule before you plan around it.

The office is open Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Outside those hours you can email vgcarpentry@yahoo.com with your project details and a few photos, and Josh will get back to you during business hours.

items.q: Can you build a custom vanity or other wood pieces?
items.a: Yes. This is a carpentry shop first. The crew has built a solid mahogany floating vanity with hidden plumbing, a white oak dining table and bench, a zebra wood headboard with built-in lamps, and walnut inlay work. Ask about a built piece for your remodel.

items.q: How do I get a price for my bathroom?
items.a: Call (337) 380-6913 or email vgcarpentry@yahoo.com with a short description and a few photos of the room. Josh will set up a time to see the space, talk through your ideas, and price the work. Reviewers describe the pricing as accurate and the jobs as on budget.
